plugin_info.details: This plugin identifies PubChem-catalogued compounds that are structurally similar to compounds chosen from your project.
plugin_info.intro: Build a compound library of chemically similar analogs by searching the PubChem database.
plugin_info.menu_path: Compounds/[8] Create Library/[2] Find Similar Compounds...
plugin_info.title: Find Similar Compounds

user_args.description: Choose what kinds of molecules to retrieve from PubChem. Stereochemistry (chirality and E/Z double-bond geometry) is ignored.
user_args.label: PubChem compounds to retrieve

user_args.description: Value between 0 and 100. A higher threshold finds more similar compounds (95 is very similar, 80 is moderately similar).
user_args.label: Similarity threshold

user_args.description: Maximum number of compounds to retrieve from PubChem.
user_args.label: Maximum results

user_args.description: Choose how to generate 3D atomic coordinates.
user_args.label: Generate 3D coordinates

options.description: fastest: no forcefield optimization or conformer search
fast: quick forcefield optimization, no conformer search
medium: quick forcefield optimization and fast conformer search
better: medium forcefield optimization and fast conformer search
best: max forcefield optimization and thorough conformer search

user_args.val: This process may take some time for multiple molecules. Check the Jobs panel to monitor progress.
